title: Would you let your baby sleep in a box
titleChinese: 你愿意让自己的宝宝在盒子里睡觉吗？
paragraphs: Having a newborn can be daunting. What do you need to buy? How will you get the baby to sleep? And how will you pay for everything? Could the answers to these worries lie in a 'baby box'?

The baby box has taken the world by storm, but what is it? Well, it originated in Finland in the 1930s as a kind of maternity kit for expectant parents provided by the government. The box contains supplies, such as bibs, nappies, and teething toys. It also comes with a small mattress, which is placed in the bottom of the box to create the baby's first cot. Now, the idea of putting a child to sleep in a box may shock some. But, experts say this could reduce the risks that come with babies sleeping in the same bed as their parents. The box has been a huge success and is said to be one of the main reasons why the rate of infant mortality in Finland is so low.

A few years ago, stories of the Finnish baby box went viral. Other countries around the world have since caught onto the idea and adapted to suit local needs. For example, in South Africa, the box is made of plastic and can be used as a bath rather than a bed. The main objective, however, is to encourage mothers to attend antenatal classes during their pregnancy. The version trialled in India includes other appropriate supplies, such as a mosquito net to protect babies from malaria.

In Canada, additions to the baby box include a "crib-side assistance booklet" to help fathers bond with their baby. Written in the style of a car-repair manual, the booklet offers first-time dads helpful advice on matters such as how to burp their child.

Of course, the baby box can only do so much. Many believe governments should focus on providing parents with adequate maternity leave and paternity leave and improving health care and education. Good things come in small packages though, and for such a simple idea the baby box really does tick a lot of boxes!

vocabulary.entry: daunting [adj.] /ˈdɔːntɪŋ/ 令人畏惧的；使人气馁的
vocabulary.example: The task seemed daunting at first, but we managed to complete it.
vocabulary.translation: 这项任务一开始看起来很艰巨，但我们设法完成了。

vocabulary.entry: take the world by storm [phr.] /teɪk ðə wɜːld baɪ stɔːm/ 风靡全球；使大为轰动 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: The new smartphone took the world by storm.
vocabulary.translation: 这款新智能手机风靡全球。

vocabulary.entry: originate in [phr.] /əˈrɪdʒɪneɪt ɪn/ 起源于 (书面语)
vocabulary.example: The custom originates in medieval times.
vocabulary.translation: 这个习俗起源于中世纪。

vocabulary.entry: maternity kit [n.] /məˈtɜːnəti kɪt/ 产妇用品套装 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: The hospital provides a free maternity kit to expectant mothers.
vocabulary.translation: 医院向准妈妈们提供免费的产妇用品套装。

vocabulary.entry: expectant parents [n. pl.] /ɪkˈspektənt ˈpeərənts/ 准父母 (单数: expectant parent)
vocabulary.example: The class is designed for expectant parents.
vocabulary.translation: 这门课程是为准父母设计的。

vocabulary.entry: bib [n.] /bɪb/ 围嘴；围兜
vocabulary.example: The baby wore a bib to keep his clothes clean.
vocabulary.translation: 宝宝戴着围嘴以保持衣服干净。

vocabulary.entry: nappy [n.] /ˈnæpi/ 尿布 (英式英语，美式: diaper)
vocabulary.example: She changed the baby's nappy.
vocabulary.translation: 她给宝宝换了尿布。

vocabulary.entry: teething toy [n.] /ˈtiːðɪŋ tɔɪ/ 出牙期玩具
vocabulary.example: Teething toys help soothe sore gums.
vocabulary.translation: 出牙期玩具有助于舒缓牙龈疼痛。

vocabulary.entry: mattress [n.] /ˈmætrɪs/ 床垫
vocabulary.example: A good mattress is essential for a good night's sleep.
vocabulary.translation: 一张好床垫对于一夜好眠至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: cot [n.] /kɒt/ 婴儿床 (英式英语，美式: crib)
vocabulary.example: The baby slept peacefully in his cot.
vocabulary.translation: 宝宝在他的婴儿床里安静地睡着。

vocabulary.entry: infant mortality [n.] /ˈɪnfənt mɔːˈtæləti/ 婴儿死亡率 (专业词汇)
vocabulary.example: Infant mortality has decreased significantly in recent decades.
vocabulary.translation: 近几十年来婴儿死亡率显著下降。

vocabulary.entry: go viral [phr.] /ɡəʊ ˈvaɪrəl/ 迅速传播；走红 (口语)
vocabulary.example: The video of the dancing cat went viral overnight.
vocabulary.translation: 那只跳舞猫的视频一夜之间走红了。

vocabulary.entry: catch onto [phr.] /kætʃ ˈɒntə/ 理解；开始接受 (口语)
vocabulary.example: It took a while for the public to catch onto the idea.
vocabulary.translation: 公众花了一段时间才接受这个想法。

vocabulary.entry: adapt to [phr.] /əˈdæpt tuː/ 适应；使适应
vocabulary.example: The species adapted to its new environment quickly.
vocabulary.translation: 这个物种很快适应了新环境。

vocabulary.entry: antenatal [adj.] /ˌæntiˈneɪtl/ 产前的 (英式英语，美式: prenatal；医学词汇)
vocabulary.example: Antenatal classes prepare parents for childbirth.
vocabulary.translation: 产前课程帮助父母为分娩做准备。

vocabulary.entry: pregnancy [n.] /ˈpreɡnənsi/ 怀孕；妊娠期
vocabulary.example: She is in her third month of pregnancy.
vocabulary.translation: 她怀孕三个月了。

vocabulary.entry: mosquito net [n.] /məˈskiːtəʊ net/ 蚊帐
vocabulary.example: Sleeping under a mosquito net prevents malaria.
vocabulary.translation: 在蚊帐里睡觉可以预防疟疾。

vocabulary.entry: malaria [n.] /məˈleəriə/ 疟疾 (医学词汇)
vocabulary.example: Malaria is a serious disease transmitted by mosquitoes.
vocabulary.translation: 疟疾是一种由蚊子传播的严重疾病。

vocabulary.entry: crib-side assistance booklet [n.] /krɪb saɪd əˈsɪstəns ˈbʊklət/ 婴儿床边辅助手册 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: The crib-side assistance booklet offers tips for new fathers.
vocabulary.translation: 这本婴儿床边辅助手册为准爸爸们提供了小贴士。

vocabulary.entry: bond with [phr.] /bɒnd wɪð/ 与……建立亲密关系 (固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: Fathers need time to bond with their newborns.
vocabulary.translation: 父亲需要时间与新生儿建立亲密关系。

vocabulary.entry: manual [n.] /ˈmænjuəl/ 手册；指南
vocabulary.example: Read the manual before assembling the furniture.
vocabulary.translation: 组装家具前请阅读说明书。

vocabulary.entry: burp [v.] /bɜːp/ 打嗝；给……拍嗝 (口语)
vocabulary.example: He gently burped the baby after feeding him.
vocabulary.translation: 喂完奶后他轻轻地给宝宝拍嗝。

vocabulary.entry: adequate [adj.] /ˈædɪkwət/ 足够的；充足的
vocabulary.example: The workers need adequate training to do the job.
vocabulary.translation: 工人们需要足够的培训来完成这项工作。

vocabulary.entry: maternity leave [n.] /məˈtɜːnəti liːv/ 产假
vocabulary.example: She is taking six months of maternity leave.
vocabulary.translation: 她正在休六个月的产假。

vocabulary.entry: paternity leave [n.] /pəˈtɜːnəti liːv/ 陪产假
vocabulary.example: New fathers are entitled to two weeks of paternity leave.
vocabulary.translation: 新爸爸有权享受两周的陪产假。

vocabulary.entry: tick a lot of boxes [phr.] /tɪk ə lɒt əv ˈbɒksɪz/ 满足很多要求 (口语；固定搭配)
vocabulary.example: This candidate ticks a lot of boxes for the job.
vocabulary.translation: 这位候选人在很多方面都符合这份工作的要求。
